about: Reid DeChant, the owner of DeChant Law in Denver, Colorado, is a formidable force in criminal defense, with a particular knack for tackling DUI/DWAI cases, vehicular assault and vehicular homicides. His practice is defined by a deep commitment to his clients' stories, ensuring that each narrative is heard and fought for in the courtroom, regardless of the accusations. His training is steeped in defending against impaired driving allegations, and he actively imparts the latest DUI defense strategies to Colorado attorneys. Regularly standing up against both the DMV and the courts, he emphasizes the critical importance of hiring a seasoned DUI defense attorney to navigate the myriad potential pitfalls.

Hailing from Scottsdale, Arizona, Mr. DeChant embarked on his academic journey with a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Arizona State University. His passion for the law led him to Denver, Colorado, where he pursued his legal education at the University of Denver–Sturm College of Law. During his time in law school, he sharpened his courtroom prowess as a member of the National Trial Team.

Mr. DeChant's dedication to trial advocacy and client-focused representation flourished at the Colorado Public Defender’s Office in Denver and Brighton, where he discovered his true calling in defending the accused. Unwavering in his readiness to take any case to trial if a favorable resolution can't be reached, he continually perfects his trial advocacy skills through nationwide training programs, ensuring he remains at the top of his game.

Understanding that many of his clients come to him during the most challenging times of their lives, Mr. DeChant is known for his honesty and transparency, offering a candid assessment of each case. His goal is to lay out all the facts, enabling clients to make well-informed decisions about their legal strategies. From negotiating favorable plea deals in cases ranging from traffic violations to first-degree homicides, he tirelessly explores every possible avenue to secure the best outcomes for his clients, no matter the circumstances.
